newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece cuts o/n intervention bid to 11.90%.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece cuts o/n intervention bid to 11.90%.

text.p: Bank of Greece cut its overnight intervention bid 50 basis points to 11.90 percent from 12.40 percent, citing easing inflationary pressures and projections of lower inflation in the months ahead, it said.
The Greek central bank will cut its Lombard and discount rates each by 100 basis points to 20 percent and 15.5 percent, respectively.
Both rates are out of line with much lower market interest rates.
